corrections.subject: request accounting
corrections.what_was_wrong: api_request_attempts charged only the agent-loop calls, so the row ledger under-reported the true charge: the batch consumed 303 recorded agent calls plus 47 auxiliary summary calls = 350 charged requests against a declared cap of 336
corrections.why_it_matters: the pre-registered cap is a cap on all requests and the protocol says summary requests are fully charged, so the batch as recorded exceeded its declared bound
corrections.fix: run_crewai_handoff_v17 now charges every request per sample (api_request_attempts = all charged requests, with agent_request_attempts and auxiliary_request_attempts as a breakdown), and the r17 batch is re-run under the same freeze so the ledger closes inside the cap
corrections.human_note: the human read the log's exit and reported 303/336; the auxiliary summary requests were the missing term, not a human arithmetic error

freeze_untouched.note: the freeze file is not rewritten; the accounting fix is registered in its amendment, which pins the new runner digest
